claims.claim_ar: حصرُ جميع ما قبلها — صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي — في مِلك ووجهة واحدة: لِلهِ
claims.claim_en: Restriction/exclusivity: all the enumerated items (my prayer, my sacrifice, my life, my death) are confined/exclusively for God (lillāh).
claims.rhetorical_effect: Conveys total devotion and exclusive dedication of actions and existence to God; produces theological absoluteness and moral clarity.

claims.source_quote_ar: قُلْ: إِنِّي عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي
claims.claim_ar: افتتاح بالآمرة «قُلْ» لِتقديم القول على أنه مستأنَف ومؤكَّد؛ أسلوب استئنافي وبياني يهيئ المتلقي لبيان حاسم.
claims.claim_en: Use of the imperative 'qul' as a prefatory, authoritative style: it resumes and foregrounds what follows, framing the statement as assertive and decisive.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Sets an assertive tone and signals that what follows is a definitive personal declaration; increases the directive force and clarity of the proclamation.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال 'إنَّ' (أو صيغة التأكيد المشابهة) لتوكيد الخبر وإبرازه — تأكيد أن ما يذكر هو مقول القول، أي تأكيد للقسم/القرار.
claims.claim_en: Use of the emphatic particle (Inna / similar) to emphasize and foreground the predicate — it marks the statement as the affirmed proposition (emphatic assertion).
claims.needs_review_reason: assignment of the precise ma‘nī-subtype to the particle 'إِنَّ' is approximate; the sources mention its syntactic role ('إن واسمها') and emphasis but do not map it to the exact subtype labels used here.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Emphasizes the personal declaration that follows, heightening the weight of the speaker's exclusive dedication.
